description: Rigid-translation test of the qz force labels (docs/na-label-grid-error.md, steps 2-3). Each run takes one training-side labelled frame, shifts it rigidly along x by k*h/n_shifts (k = 0..n_shifts-1, h = cell/N, N = finest-grid size of that run's setting) and recomputes it with the frame's own qz input, changing only the setting. Exact forces do not change under a rigid shift: the spread of the forces over the shifts measures the grid (egg-box) error directly, without a model.
